description: Structural and code-list validation of an IVMS 101.2023 travel-rule payload supplied as a ZERO-PII skeleton: every free-text leaf must be the literal SYNTHETIC or a {"len": n} max-length marker; country/name/address/identifier type codes are validated against the pinned code lists; cardinality, max-length, edition and the C1-C12 constraints (required entities, mutually exclusive natural/legal person branches, legal-name-present, valid address, national-identifier completeness, LEI/RA formats, transfer-path sequence integrity) are checked per the pinned standard. Output is paths, rule ids and verdicts only - the kernel never echoes a leaf value, and any real free-text leaf is refused by path. Exclusions: full ISO-3166 and GLEIF Registration Authority lists are checked at format level only; LEI convention is length-checked only on len markers; C2 date-in-past is evaluated against the pinned 2026-11-01 build date, not a runtime clock.
